description: This source file defines the ControlChannel class and related data structures for managing a control communication channel in a macOS application. It handles connection states, health checks, event streams, error handling, and interaction with external services such as a gateway, including reconnection and recovery mechanisms.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the control communication channel, including establishing connections, handling states, processing events, and reconciling failures with recovery mechanisms.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initial configuration method, optionally setting mode to remote with target and identity.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Refreshes the connection endpoint, attempting to establish or re-establish the gateway connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the current connection, resets relevant state variables.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the control channel, returning diagnostic data.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Fetches the last heartbeat event received from the control channel.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the control gateway with specified method and parameters, returning raw data.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Converts error instances into user-friendly messages specific to gateway connection issues.

methods.name: scheduleRecovery
methods.description: Schedules reconnection attempts after connection failures, with throttle control.

methods.name: establishGatewayConnection
methods.description: Establishes a stable connection with the gateway and verifies health.

methods.name: refreshAuthSourceLabel
methods.description: Updates the label indicating the authentication source in use.

methods.name: formatAuthSource
methods.description: Formats the description of the authentication source for display.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message via the control channel.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Initializes the subscription to incoming push events from the gateway.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming push events, including agent data, heartbeat signals, and gateway shutdowns.

methods.name: routeWorkActivity
methods.description: Routes activity data based on event stream type, updating internal stores accordingly.

methods.name: bridgeToProtocolArgs
methods.description: Converts nested Codable structures to protocol-compatible key-value dictionaries.
